item.title: Joshua Maddux Was Found in a Chimney 7 Years After Disappearing
item.description: In 2008, 18-year-old Joshua Maddux vanished from his Colorado hometown. His remains were discovered inside an abandoned cabin's chimney in 2015. Authorities ruled his death accidental, but questions about the scene remained.

item.title: Ashanti Billie's Murder Led to a New U.S. Missing Persons Law
item.description: In 2017, 19-year-old Ashanti Billie was abducted in Virginia and found murdered 11 days later. Her case inspired the Ashanti Alert Act of 2018, helping authorities alert the public about missing adults who fall outside existing alert systems.
